input database.title: Input database
input database.description: Open a tileDB-SOMA database by URI.

input_uri.description: A URI pointing to a TileDB-SOMA database.

s3_region.description: Region where the TileDB-SOMA database is hosted.

endpoint.description: Custom endpoint to use to connect to S3

s3_no_sign_request.description: Do not sign S3 requests. Credentials will not be loaded if this argument is provided.

input_modality.description: TileDB-SOMA measurement to take the input from.

input_layers.description: Layers to import from TileDB-SOMA database.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `output.h5mu`

output_modality.description: Name of the modality to write the results to.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
